allergic contact dermatitis: Lichenified plaques with accentuated skin markings
cellulitis impetigo and other bacterial: Dermal papillae with linear vascular pattern
Subtle pigment network with irregular dots
paronychia: Nail fold, swollen, tender to touch
pilomatricoma: Central pearly mass with satellite nodules
pityriasis rubra pilaris: Homogeneous red background with white scales
Symmetric distribution on hands and feet
telangiectases: On sun-exposed skin, chronic UV damage
